basics.name: Gabriel Asael Tarigan
basics.summary: Applied ML lecturer at BINUS University. I teach it, I build it, I run it: curriculum design, production ML systems, and research in time-series forecasting.

work.position: Lecturer, Artificial Intelligence Program (School of Computer Science)
work.summary: Designed and authored the AI program's core curriculum (5 courses authored, 2 co-authored): ML foundations, applied NLP, deep learning, MLOps, signal processing, IoT & robotics. Build and operate the production systems that run the program: ML competition platform, course quiz portals, interactive teaching tools. Research in deep learning for time-series forecasting.

publications.name: Parallelization of LSTM-GRU Architectures for Multivariate Prediction of Stock Prices
publications.summary: Hybrid LSTM-GRU architectures, parallelized for multivariate stock price prediction and benchmarked against transformer-based comparators.

teaching.description: Building and operating ML systems end-to-end: experimentation, model serving, monitoring, and production discipline.
5 courses authored, 2 co-authored: ML foundations, applied NLP, deep learning, MLOps, signal processing, IoT & robotics.
